metadata.scenario: A customer calls to contest a charge from the subscription service they have been billed for twice in one month. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Robert Jackson. I’m calling because I noticed I was billed twice this month for the subscription service. I’m sorry to hear that, Robert. Let me take a look at your account. Can you hold for just a moment? Sure, no problem. Thank you for waiting. I see that there were two charges of $150 this month for the subscription service. Can you confirm if you were expecting that? I thought I was only supposed to be charged once a month. I’ve been a client for three years and this is the first time it’s happened. I understand your concern, Robert. It looks like there might have been a processing error. So, what can we do about it? I will need to escalate this issue to our billing department to investigate further. Can I get your permission to proceed with that? Yes, please. I want to resolve this as soon as possible. Great! I’ll also need to confirm your email address. Is it still rjackson@email.com? Yes, that’s correct. Thank you. I’ll update you once I have more information from billing. Okay, thank you. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome! In the meantime, would you like to schedule an additional personal care assistant visit? It might be helpful during this busy period. Actually, yes. I could use some extra help with personal care next week. Perfect! How many hours would you need? I think I’ll need about three hours. Alright. I’ll arrange that for you and make sure the caregiver is briefed on your specific requirements. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate that. No problem, Robert. I’m here to help! I’ll send you a confirmation email for the appointment and an update on the billing issue. Sounds good. Thanks again. You’re welcome! Have a great day, Robert! You too, bye! Bye!
